evidence: The crop looked stressed in 10 weeks over 2015-2026 (both checks agree), mostly early September; most often weaker growth than in its other rice years (NASA MODIS and Sentinel-2) and hot leaves for the air temperature (NASA MODIS).

latest_season.evidence: The crop looked stressed in 7 weeks over the 2026 season (both checks agree), mostly early August; most often weaker growth than in its other rice years (NASA MODIS and Sentinel-2) and very thirsty air (high reference evapotranspiration) (NOAA stations and NASA POWER).

julaug_2022.note: 2022: Fallow/Idle Cropland on this field (no crop to stress)

fallow_not_stress.note: fallow weeks are scored (they look anomalous) but are shown as fallow, never as crop stress, and are left out of the evidence sentence

events_source: US Drought Monitor county statistics: weeks with >= 50% of the county in D3 (extreme) or D4 (exceptional) drought, cumulative statistic, max over the field's counties
how_to_read: A week is flagged when the field looks unusual for that week of the year in a stress direction. Both checks = stronger evidence. No labelled stress events exist, so there is no accuracy; the Drought Monitor weeks show whether flags line up with known drought.
